_install: SERVER (Node/Express) variant of the kit — same 4 rules; catch-must-log additionally accepts `next(err)` (forwarding to the terminal error middleware, which owns logging). Add devDependency eslint-plugin-promise, merge rules+overrides into the server/shared package.json eslintConfig (env: node, es2022, sourceType: module), add "promise" to plugins. Generalize override paths to the app's real logger/sink locations. See references/server-patterns.md §ESLint.

no-restricted-syntax.message: This catch block swallows the error silently. Do exactly one of: (1) call logger.error/logger.warn(...) to record it, (2) re-throw it with `throw` so an upstream catch or the process net handles it, or (3) forward it with `next(error)` so the terminal error middleware logs it and returns a safe JSON response. The only allowed silent path is an intentional AbortController cancel: `if (e.name === 'AbortError') return;`.
